statistical_unit: independent session seed within each SNR; six seeds; four SNR results are separate
interval: unadjusted two-sided Student t 95% interval over six session-level values; not multiplicity adjusted or confirmatory
limitations: frames within session are correlated and not treated as independent
pre-registered window BER uses fixed disjoint windows
a confidence interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not equivalence
intervals were derived after completion and do not replace frozen confirmatory design
